notes.title: Developer Log – New Content Showcase & V0.9 Update
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hello everyone! I'm SlackCat, the developer of Windstop Strategy. It's been quite a while since I last updated you on the development progress. During this absence, we've been continuously monitoring various suggestions and feedback from our community players, and have set new directions for the game's future development.[/p][p][/p][p]After two small-scale internal tests and several months of polishing, the V0.9 major content update for Windstop Strategy Demo is finally ready to meet everyone! So this time, let me explain what new content and gameplay this update will bring![/p][p][/p][h1]1. Combat Changes[/h1][p][/p][p]First point: Windstop Strategy's combat WILL NOT be changed to a card-based system!!! We have completely abandoned card-based modifications!! Additionally, we've added some new mechanics to the combat foundation - details can be found in the [b]update log at the end[/b].[/p][p]The current combat system mainly simplifies the previous version by removing the mana mechanics (Inner Power and Qi Gathering), strengthening skill mechanics, and splitting each turn into a Strategy Phase and Combat Phase.[/p][p][/p][h2]Strategy Phase[/h2][p]In the Strategy Phase, you can see the enemy's skill sequence and decide your own skill order based on the current battlefield situation.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/e37a750cd82d5d0100fc518bf9641dc00d163a57.png"][/img][/p][p]After setting your skill sequence, click the 【Fight】 button on the right to enter the Combat Phase.[/p][p][/p][h2]Combat Phase[/h2][p]Similar to the old combat system, characters will execute skills in the predetermined order, except that skill execution now alternates between allies and enemies. After all skills are executed, all characters will perform a basic attack based on their speed stat.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/1d85fa0a62f1a25cf5e176ff52a0d52e755f9972.png"][/img][/p][h2]Auto Combat[/h2][p]In auto combat mode, the AI will decide skill usage for you, behaving essentially the same as the old version's combat.[/p][p]We've also simplified the skill targeting system (previously similar to Unicorn Overlord's programming approach). Most attack skills now prioritize targets in the same row, while healing skills favor characters with lower HP. This places more emphasis on character positioning and skill usage decisions during combat.[/p][p][/p][h1]2. Character Progression Adjustments[/h1][p][/p][h2]Enhanced Character Differentiation[/h2][p][/p][p]In previous versions, many special NPC characters felt too similar to generic characters, especially after being fully developed. Beyond unique artwork/models and storylines, even when unlocking exclusive equipment, players might prefer giving it to stronger generic characters.[/p][p][/p][p]Therefore, we've essentially reworked all recruitable characters' initial traits, strengthening their unique functionalities. These traits can be further upgraded as character stories progress.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/ede744de947e91a39ca8c20133322b35044c3266.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We've also designed some exclusive legendary treasures for different characters.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/7d4def1e8d6928df162b64f6341d7e164a73d20d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]3. BOSS Battles[/h1][p][/p][p]As more factions unlock in later game stages, simple attack/defense battles might feel monotonous. Therefore, we're introducing unique BOSS battles at certain faction story points or dungeons, emphasizing formation and combat strategy.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/2c10248db321146acd7ca2f7a4f8918a45ed821c.png"][/img][/p][p]The V0.9 test version includes one challenging BOSS battle for players to experience.[/p][p][/p][h1]4. World Map Strategy[/h1][p][/p][p]For special map strategy gameplay, our current design leans more toward Sengoku Rance's approach - triggering events by spending action points to provide multiple approaches for conquering factions.[/p][p]Reasons: 1) Strong main story events conflict with pure sandbox strategy gameplay (like Paradox-style grand strategy or Total War's economic/diplomatic systems); 2) Our team's current size and resources can't support developing a complete grand strategy game.[/p][p]Thus, our focus remains on polishing core gameplay. However, we plan to add a story-free sandbox mode in the future to implement deeper farming/diplomacy mechanics separately from story events.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/6c23f54acb40b6ea7f0034293f741c2a738f8d4c.png"][/img][/p][h1]5. Visual Improvements[/h1][p]We've upgraded the game's overall visual presentation, now implemented in the V0.9 Demo.[/p][p][/p][h2]UI Overhaul[/h2][p]We've redesigned most UIs to unify the art style and optimize information display.[/p][p] [/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/1f68a3acc5a57a6cb01b0c16b134e53eb0fcaab5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/ec30b26cc90b82e10cba10b4c692f778018c408f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/b8813a20a3ac37bb208c8db02aebe1dcc2b42607.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/f90bbe3fab76210ce29deb762deebfa4e6a4f737.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/b7d8cca454cd353dc0c1f307af87f15def8b4519.png"][/img] [/carousel][p] [/p][h2]Character Art[/h2][p][/p][p]We've replaced all generic faction NPC AI-generated art with hand-drawn illustrations.[/p][p][/p][h2]Combat Visuals[/h2][p][/p][p]We've adjusted hit/knockback animations and designed special effects/performances for BOSS battles. More enhancements (animations, effects, etc.) will come in the full release.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/3c5969bfdb8735a732b0f6e17ca55b7eea5099cd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]6. Story Content[/h1][p][/p][p]Now about the story - we've categorized it into several types:[/p][p][/p][h2]Main Story[/h2][p][/p][p]The main story follows a multi-ending, multi-playthrough structure divided into phases. At each phase, you may need to complete key events or make crucial decisions.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/c2f362211cdf8acdf488a9f3ad05f35b2cabc2ce.png"][/img][/p][p]Some choices may affect final battle difficulty, while others directly influence endings.[/p][p][/p][h2]Faction Stories[/h2][p][/p][p]Faction stories provide plot clues and may have different routes (like existing Demo content - Dragon Bay's Boar Branch that observant players may have noticed).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/69a1ac1b4b987f3700e9a0c7645ec0cac989f4e8.png"][/img][/p][p]Later factions will have fewer branching paths to streamline the narrative.[/p][p][/p][h2]Dungeons[/h2][p][/p][p]The Daughter Village dungeon proved successful in testing, offering good expansion opportunities:[/p][list][*][p]Additional character backstory and recruitment motivation[/p][/*][*][p]Hidden plot clues rewarding legendary items[/p][/*][*][p]Alternative faction conquest strategies (like defeating a faction boss early)[/p][/*][*][p]Repeatable dungeons for farming resources[/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Subsequent faction dungeons follow this design as narrative supplements and high-end reward sources.[/p][p][/p][h2]Character Stories[/h2][p][/p][p]Character stories remain as character development and personality supplements.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]7. MOD Support[/h1][p][/p][p]About MODs: Due to significant V0.9 changes, old saves and MODs won't work. We'll provide MOD migration tools before official release to help MOD authors update their work.[/p][p][/p][p]That covers this dev log's content. The full update log is below for reference.[/p][p][/p][h3]:zs_coffee::zs_coffee: [b]V0.9 Update Content [/b]:zs_coffee::zs_coffee:[/h3][p][/p][p][b] Major Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Combat system overhaul including talents, skills, traits, buffs, Tiger Flame points, equipment, and BOSS battles[/p][/*][*][p]Numerical adjustments and corresponding story rewards, character creation mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue and cutscene optimizations, plus reorganized early-game story[/p][/*][*][p]New trait system: permanent traits can upgrade but have activation limits; starting traits adjusted[/p][/*][*][p]High-difficulty item use limits: each character has usage caps per item type[/p][/*][*][p]Injury system changed from percentage-based to fixed values, affecting related items/healing[/p][/*][*][p]Massive UI redesigns and optimizations[/p][/*][*][p]Combat visuals and sound effects improved[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy BOSS presentation and skill effects notes.title: Developer Log: Combat System Rework
notes.content:
Hello everyone, long time no see! Today We'll share our development approach and future plans for optimizing the combat system.

[b]The following content represents prototype designs and concepts still under adjustment, which may differ from the final version.[/b]

[b]Core optimization directions for WindStop Strategy's combat system:[/b]

- Enhanced pre-battle information display and interface optimization.

- Streamlined combat pacing with added strategic planning between rounds.

- Strengthened buff/debuff mechanics for deeper tactical counterplay.

[h1]1. Pre-Battle Deployment Interface Adjustments[/h1]

[h2]Pre-Battle Preparations[/h2]

Added secondary pop-up windows for both allies and enemies to view opponent attributes and enable quick equipment/skill swaps for your team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/e9a1cd22fff7b2a26e025dd418a4807365d2c030.png[/img]

[h1]2. Combat & Skill Flow Adjustments[/h1]

[h2]Strategic Objective Changes[/h2]

We found that the programming-style tactical system (similar to "Unicorn Overlord") proved too hardcore for many players, with late-game micromanagement becoming tedious. Therefore, we're removing the tactical programming feature and implementing fixed targeting logic for all skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/7cac0e0ce53d8a35d03e38dc26f2febace237ee5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/611c52ce5d0ed6d440fd515dce27fefc76bbceb8.png[/img]

[b]All active skills and basic attacks will now automatically target enemies in the same row.[/b]

When no targets remain in the same row:

- Top row prioritizes targets from top to bottom.

- Bottom row prioritizes targets from bottom to top.

- Middle row selects targets based on skill priority, with random selection if equal priority.

- This shifts strategic emphasis to formation positioning across upper/middle/lower rows.

[h2]Skill Simplification[/h2]

- Removed Focus/Inner Energy resource systems (no more skill costs)

- Cooldowns now reset per combat round instead of per basic attack

- Active skills become more powerful but with limited uses per battle

- Players manually decide skill usage at round start based on battle state

- Skills execute in preset order, while Speed affects basic attack sequence and chase skill triggers

[h2]Combat Flow Restructure[/h2]

New two-phase combat flow: [b]Strategy Phase[/b] and [b]Execution Phase[/b]

[h3]Strategy Phase[/h3]

- Players arrange skill cards in a sequence slot while enemies preset their own skill order:

- High-difficulty enemies hide their skill cards (some reveal mechanics available)

- Auto-pause during planning phase for tactical consideration

- Limited powerful skill cards require careful timing

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/4a2f11947c6baaed0d9ba3c7370f7d360b773f60.png[/img]
[b](Image conveys prototype concept, not final version)[/b]

Hovering skills highlights users and targeting priorities:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/c326bd4aba2c954e49c73aad9f1dca03fc99c121.png[/img]
[b](Image conveys prototype concept, not final version)[/b]

Early game features simpler card systems (max 3 cards per character: External/Internal/Lightness techniques). Tiger Flame Points unlock more card slots.

[h3]Execution Phase[/h3]

Skills alternate between both parties using sequence: Attacker's 1st card → Defender's 1st card → Attacker's 2nd card, etc.

Example sequence: e,1,d,2,c,3,b,4,a,5,6.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/5d39ee6db45949541dc7259eafd58dd03ea54dcd.png[/img]

This enables counterplay strategies (e.g., using early cards to disrupt dangerous enemy skills).

After skill resolution, basic attacks occur in Speed order.

[h3]Auto-Battle[/h3]

Removed all player controls - fully AI-driven. Added quick battle interface to skip 3D animations for trivial fights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/a0608f5f87e824514b33b3457a7573ecce421953.png[/img]

[h1]3. Buff Mechanism Adjustments[/h1]

Simplified all effects:

Cooldown: External/Internal/Lightness CDR attributes.

Poison: 5% current HP damage (max 3 stacks), dispellable.

Bleed: 5% missing HP damage per round (max 3 stacks), removed at full HP.

Burn: 3% max HP damage per action + 20% heal reduction (max 3 stacks).

Combo: 5% basic attack damage per stack (max 10), 5% chase chance per stack.

Charge Skills: Telegraphed powerful delayed attacks, countered by stuns.

Silence: Blocks active skills.

Stun: Prevents actions, grants 50% stun resist after effect.

Paralysis: Blocks chase/counter skills.

Shield: Blocks debuffs, vulnerable to Internal damage (2x) and True damage.

Counter: Triggers after Block/Dodge, effective vs multi-hit attacks.

[h1]4. Summary[/h1]

[b]Core strategic experience now focuses on:[/b]

[h2]Pre-Battle Formation Strategy[/h2]

Counter enemy formations through positioning (e.g., deploying paralysis users against chase attackers)

[h2]In-Combat Card Play[/h2]

Manage limited skill cards against enemy patterns.

Proper sequencing enables combos and counters.




That’s all for today’s talk! We’ve mainly covered the adjustments and improvements to the combat system, aiming to make battles in WindStop Strategy more engaging and strategic.

Of course, development is still ongoing, and more changes and optimizations will be made in the future. Next time, we’ll discuss other aspects of the game’s development and improvements—stay tuned!

Thanks for your support, and see you next time!

notes.title: Developer's Log："Illustration Appreciation" Feature
notes.content:
Hello players! Long time no see. In the month following the end of the New Product Festival, we have been continuously working on the development of "Windstop Strategy." Aside from refining and polishing the game's experience based on feedback and suggestions from the festival, including aspects such as combat, balance, and storyline, we are also implementing new content according to our development plan. In this developer's log, we're excited to introduce one of the new features we're currently working on: the Illustration Appreciation feature.

[h3]Feature Description[/h3]

The Illustration Appreciation feature involves inserting CG images during the game's storyline sequences. This aims to provide players with rewarding visual feedback during key plot moments and will also be used to wrap up certain game endings.

These images generally relate to factors such as the player's affinity with key characters, important plot decisions, and the outcomes of various endings. 

[h3]Production Process[/h3]

First, we internally discussed and determined the total number of spots that require illustrations. After finalizing the number, we communicated with skilled artists on creative platforms, providing them with basic character settings and scene descriptions to start the concept design.

Example of concept design at the sketch stage (not representative of the final product design)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/7fd07a67394db2bc81f3b9d5e8ec1f0d52edb2df.png[/img]

Once the illustrator completes the sketch concept and sends it back, we conduct an internal discussion to provide some suggestions for modifications. This process is repeated until the design is finalized. After that, the illustrator begins the detailed creation work. 

[h3]Final Product Showcase[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/918f4f67afb498ffc7152d7ac125905720a564ec.png[/img]

[b]The official version of the game is expected to add dozens of CG illustrations of the same quality as those shown in the finished product. [/b]

[h3]Gallery[/h3]

Additionally, to facilitate screenshotting and repeated viewing, we will add a gallery feature to the main menu. This will allow players to easily access and review key illustrations triggered during important plot points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/892f27e2bac8d7b9fe27d725058d5fc99ffa30b8.png[/img]

In the time leading up to the official release of the game, we will continue to share our development progress with players through "Developer Logs." Finally, thank you all for your ongoing interest and support for the game. We will keep working hard!

notes.title: V0.6 playtest is now available!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

After more than a month of development, the [b]Playtest V0.6 Update[/b] for WindStopStrategy is finally ready to be officially unveiled! Let us walk you through the new content of this V0.6 update~

First up, we are excited to showcase the highlight of this update: the Module Editor, one of the core features of WindStopStrategy, which will make its debut in V0.6 for the first round of testing. In addition, to make it easier for everyone to upload, download, and install mods, we have added an in-game [b]Creative Workshop[/b], which is expected to be available around the Mid-Autumn Festival. The official Steam Workshop support will be launched alongside the official game release, so stay tuned!

A reminder to all: with the opening of the Module Editor test, we are also launching the [url=https://wsa.feuxon.com/]feedback and creative event[/url] for the MOD editor. We have prepared generous prizes for participants. Whether you're an artist, a numbers expert, or a story writer, as long as you're interested in modding and are willing to join us in witnessing the growth of WindStopStrategy's community content ecosystem, you're welcome to join our [url=https://link.ioigamer.net/q.php?type=43]Elite Co-creation QQ group: 897933161[/url] to learn more about the event and get access to the [b]exclusive test branch[/b] of the Module Editor. Become one of the [b]first MOD creators[/b] for WindStopStrategy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/c82199a8af97eeed816e8857d84d5a9cbf5d1d46.jpg[/img]

We have completed the initial polishing of the editor, and the test version will include features such as portrait imports, 3D character model imports, music and cutscene imports, basic data modifications, and support for custom Lua scripts. Moving forward, based on our development plan and user feedback, we will continue to add more features and improve the user experience for the editor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/0c65c007c46d120e1aef41d9d09c4437cea682b8.jpg[/img]

That's the update related to the MOD editor. Now, let’s look at what other key updates are included in V0.6.

[h3]Map Strategy Expansion[/h3]

[list] []Added more strategic actions on the world map to enrich the gameplay. [/list] [list] []A new event, "Investigate Specialties," has been added when occupying a location, allowing players to view special items produced at the location, providing strategic information for attacking or developing a region. [/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/98f5baf592d3e1570962c09f1054c31d0eeef92d.png[/img] [list] [*]New strategic actions include looting and destruction, threatening and intimidating, and stealth assassinations. [/list]

[h3]Music[/h3]

[list] [*]Added over a dozen new original tracks, replacing all music that didn’t fit the martial arts theme. [/list]

[h3]Art Assets[/h3]

[list] [*]Added a batch of new NPC characters. [/list] Here are some examples: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/e75045e9ff12762453942ea8b50e8c2b62a40c94.png[/img]

[h3]Others[/h3]

[list] [*]Added support for Traditional Chinese language. [/list]

[h3]Optimization[/h3]
[list] 
[*]Optimization: The Fortune Training system now includes a re-randomization mechanic, and different affixes will have varying refresh probabilities based on the character’s class.

[*]Optimization: All shops now offer a greater variety of equipment and items.

[*]Optimization: The drag-and-drop feel for world map actions has been improved, with smoother acceleration and deceleration for dragging and mouse scrolling.

[*]Optimization: Characters now shout battle cries when performing certain combat skills to avoid the awkwardness of silent fighting.

[*]Optimization: Added a save folder location button in the save menu for easier save file management. Main game saves and core mod saves now have separate folders.

[*]Optimization: Adjusted AI skill-casting priority logic from a three-step progression system to one that factors in the number of conditions met + condition priority.

[*]Old logic: The higher the priority for the condition, the higher the target’s priority (e.g., Target A, which meets Condition 1, would always have higher priority than Target B, which does not).
New logic: The more conditions a target meets, the higher its priority. If the number of conditions met is the same, the one that meets higher-priority conditions comes first (e.g., Target A meets Condition 1 and Condition 2, while Target B meets Condition 2 and Condition 3; Target A would be prioritized since Condition 1 is more important).

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[*]Fixed an issue where the [Knight] talent "Offense and Defense" was not working.
[*]Fixed an issue where mouse events would trigger sounds in windowed mode even when the game [*]was not in focus.
[*]Fixed an issue where certain skill animations caused characters to constantly shift position.
[*]Fixed an issue where combat sound effects would loop infinitely when the game was paused.
[*]Fixed an issue where some skill names displayed incorrectly.
[*]Fixed a memory leak in resource caching that caused the screen to go black.
[*]Fixed an issue where the guild leader's portrait would not update when a location was captured.
[*]Fixed an issue where the "Uphold Justice" event would trigger repeatedly.
[*]Fixed an issue with reversed dialogue in certain story events.

And that’s all for the WindStopStrategy Playtest V0.6 update! Thank you all for your patience and support! After the launch of V0.6, we will continue to improve the playtest experience based on your feedback and address any issues that persist in the game. We hope you enjoy the V0.6 update, and we’ll see you in the next one!

notes.title: New beta version is on the way
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This is the first developer log since "Windstop Valley" was announced on Steam. It has been two weeks since we first invited everyone to test the game. In the days to come, until the official release of the game, we will periodically talk about the project's progress and hope to listen to your suggestions to make a better game!

Let's briefly introduce the project:

"Windstop Valley" is a strategy RPG indie game that was created in our spare time by a few friends who met through the GitHub open-source project "Heroes Legend Startup." Our game is positioned as "a story-driven, strategy-based wuxia RPG that is easy to expand with MODs." Those familiar with our work may notice that the basic system and some regional suppression mechanics are similar to Japanese-style RPGs. Indeed, we can candidly say that our inspiration comes from "Sengoku Rance," and our game can be considered a tribute to it. Of course, we are also eager to combine this niche gameplay with wuxia content to see if we can spark some new excitement.

We are delighted that since the beginning of the V0.2 test this month, we have received plenty of player suggestions and positive feedback! (We are pleasantly surprised.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/46805fc2e7a23509915f99f9929e14ed72657fa1.png[/img]

Based on the test results, we are preparing for the next test version. We plan to meet you with the V0.3 test version at the end of March, when we will release a Steam demo that everyone can experience!

Here are some improvements we are focusing on based on your feedback:

[h1]1. Art Style[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/c8ecd5c684f6f66cfc021119e71b7c8e253f9bdb.png[/img]

Although the survey results far exceeded our expectations (because we didn't focus much on the art before, and many elements were AI-generated due to limited manpower with a focus on system implementation), we have started to seriously consider the artistic direction for the final game. For example, we have redrawn the protagonist Situ Laiye (still adjusting details), and added expressions to the game's story presentation, which will all be seen in the next version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/6fb56d4a7d792de1a61444f458fdec3961a8f1d2.png[/img]

Additionally, character models, the world map, and UI are all being revamped.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/9ff1b9eb257acbea2e6b6c3d9d6c52d348497a31.png[/img]

[h1]2. Story Adjustments[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/c63bf06de590e1bc90b6f6d239dcec46fa01df78.png[/img]

In the V0.2 test survey, a significant number of players found the story too frivolous, and the overall atmosphere needed improvement. A considerable number of female players also felt the script was too "rough."
In response, we are refining all story scripts and performances, as well as rethinking the world view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/a557307304302d66d254cbef5c0febfb8e66ed1c.png[/img]

[h1]3. Interaction Adjustments[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/2ba4d27c402c8a57c90d535956ede9c2f11fa1d0.png[/img]

All existing UI/UX were temporarily cobbled together without a unified design language.
We are now comprehensively sorting this out, and the next time you see it, it won't look as "makeshift"! We will also add necessary textures, animations, and auditory effects to all interaction modules.

[h1]4. Combat Strategy[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831327/d7b619448564b6fd72d7e8a4726f2af2d0f10f76.png[/img]

We are glad that the relatively "relaxing" combat mode has been well received. Moving forward, while maintaining the core combat mode, we will make some adjustments. We'll optimize some of the more frivolous number settings and overly powerful skills, and we'll add some interesting and challenging objectives.

[h1]5. Workshop and MOD Editor[/h1]
The game will support the Steam Workshop, and we are currently doing the preparatory work for it.
We plan to provide an in-game MOD editor, integrating the game's debugging and development functions to allow every interested friend to express their creativity.
However, this module is not planned to be included in the March test content and will meet with everyone in the next version.

[h1]6. Multilingual Support[/h1]
We are preparing a multi-language translation framework, and the game will be released in a variety of languages.

That's all for today's update. Thank you for your attention, and if you like our work, consider adding it to your Steam "Wishlist"!
We look forward to sharing more about the game with you and engaging in discussions!
